blockers.detail: agents/src/trader/ does not exist in this repository. Only agents/src/firefly/ is present. The scheduled task references a trader CLI (trader scan / trader research) that has not been built yet.

fallback: LLM_BACKEND=disabled TRADER_OFFLINE=1 — not applicable because the trader CLI entrypoint does not exist.
